headerDisplay: [homebridge-intesis-accloud](https://github.com/csi-lk/homebridge-intesis-accloud) is a Homebridge plugin to interact with IntesisHome AC controllers via the Intesis cloud.

swingMode.title: Swing Mode
swingMode.description: Should swing mode affect the horizontal or vertical vanes? Defaults to horizontal.

configCacheSeconds.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
configCacheSeconds.description: How often to poll the Intesis cloud for status updates and re-attempt any pending commands. Defaults to 30.

defaultTemperature.title: Default Temperature
defaultTemperature.description: Temperature (in Celsius) to default the current temperature to when no reading is available. 0 means use the current set point. Defaults to 0.

form.title: Advanced Settings (Optional)
form.description: These are optional settings that you can adjust if needed. The defaults should work for nearly everyone.
